title: Global Assets
label:
Dr. Newton Kondaveti and Dr. Lakshmi
Founders of Quantum Life University (QLU / qluglobal.org)
summary:
Dr. Newton Kondaveti (MBBS, MD) and Dr. Lakshmi Newton (MBBS) are the founders of Quantum Life University (QLU / qluglobal.org). They are a married couple often described as soulmates across lifetimes who left conventional medicine to become “Soul Doctors.”
Who they are

Both trained as medical doctors in India. Dr. Newton completed his MBBS and MD (including postgraduate work related to Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences); Dr. Lakshmi holds an MBBS.
They realized that every person has an “Inner Doctor” and shifted from practicing conventional medicine to teaching meditation, spiritual science, and holistic healing modalities.
Titles sometimes used in their community include Brahmarshi Chakravarti Dr. Newton Kondaveti and Brahma Vidvarishta Dr. Lakshmi Newton.

Their journey and work
Dr. Newton awakened to his life purpose around age 22. Over more than 25 years they have traveled and taught extensively (reported in over 120 countries), mentoring both beginners and established practitioners in alternative healing, holistic health, and self-empowerment. He is frequently called a “teacher of teachers” who emphasizes humility, unconditional love, and “walking the talk.”
They are widely recognized as pioneers in:

Past Life Regression (and related Future Progression)
Life Between Lives (LBL) Regression
Inner Child Work
Family Constellations / Transgenerational Healing
Rebirthing Breathwork and other breath practices
Meditation and broader Spiritual Science

They integrate psychology with spirituality for deep healing and transformation. Dr. Newton has publicly shared having explored dozens of his own past lives; both have described profound out-of-body and spiritual experiences.
Quantum Life University
QLU is their vision of a modern spiritual university modeled on the ancient Indian centers of Takshashila and Nalanda. Its mission is to create an open, supportive, unconditional environment where people can learn spiritual knowledge, integrate it into daily life, and transform it into lived wisdom. The campus is located near Vikarabad (Rangareddy District, Telangana, India) on a large tract of land developed through Life Foundation (a not-for-profit trust they established).
They facilitate residential retreats, workshops, practitioner trainings, and programs on topics ranging from Past Life Regression and Inner Child healing to relationships, self-mastery, and spiritual growth. They also offer personal sessions and online resources (books, guided meditations, webinars, courses).
Dr. Lakshmi is often described as the quiet strength and multidimensional force behind the manifestation of their work; Dr. Newton has referred to her as his Guru. Together they are portrayed as complementary—unmanifest and manifest energies working as one.
In short, they are a dedicated spiritual teaching couple who turned medical training into a lifelong mission of awakening the “wisdom within” through experiential spiritual science and healing modalities, centered at their Quantum Life University campus. Their public presence emphasizes compassion, practical tools for inner transformation, and building a global community (sangha) around these teachings.
